metadata.description: Singapore MRT and LRT first and last train timings - all lines

sources.name: SBS Transit (official operator page)
sources.data_granularity: DTL: Mon-Sat first / Sun-PH first / daily last; NEL: Weekday first / Sat first / Sun-PH first / Weekday last / Weekend-PH last; LRT: Mon-Sat first / Sun-PH first / daily last

sources.name: SG Train Status (aggregates LTA and operator data)
sources.reliability: secondary - third-party aggregator citing LTA and operators
sources.data_granularity: weekday first / weekend first / weekday last / weekend last (no separate Sat vs Sun-PH distinction)
sources.notes: Timings stated as approximate. Some station directions and branches have incomplete data.

data_completeness_notes: NSL: sgtrainstatus.com provides northbound direction for all stations; southbound provided for NS1 Jurong East, NS24 Dhoby Ghaut, NS25 City Hall, NS26 Raffles Place only.

EWL: sgtrainstatus.com provides westbound direction for most stations; eastbound provided for EW12 Bugis, EW13 City Hall, EW14 Raffles Place, EW24 Jurong East only. Airport branch (CG1 Expo, CG2 Changi Airport) timing data not available from this source.

CCL: clockwise direction only (Dhoby Ghaut to HarbourFront). Counter-clockwise direction not listed. CCL Stage 6 (CC30 Keppel, CC31 Cantonment, CC32 Prince Edward Road) not yet open as of scrape date - opens 12 July 2026.

TEL: eastbound direction only. Several stations have no timing data: TE10 Mount Pleasant (not yet open), TE12 Napier (not yet open), TE13 Orchard Boulevard (not yet open), TE21 Marina South (not yet open), TE23 Tanjong Rhu through TE29 Bayshore (open since Jun 2024 but no data from this source). TEL Stage 5 (Xilin, Bedok South, Sungei Bedok) not yet open as of scrape date.
BP_LRT: loop service - single direction (loop) for all 13 stations.
SK_LRT and PG_LRT: loop services - timings show departures from town centre only.
NEL: NE2 does not exist (not assigned). Station numbering jumps from NE1 to NE3.

direction_label_conventions.NSL: northbound = from NS1 Jurong East towards NS9 Woodlands and continuing to NS28 Marina South Pier; southbound = reverse
direction_label_conventions.EWL: westbound = from EW1 Pasir Ris towards EW33 Tuas Link; eastbound = reverse
direction_label_conventions.CCL: clockwise = from CC1 Dhoby Ghaut towards CC29 HarbourFront (incomplete loop - CCL6 not yet open)
direction_label_conventions.TEL: eastbound = from TE1 Woodlands North towards TE29 Bayshore; westbound = reverse
direction_label_conventions.BP_LRT: loop = circular service (no fixed directional distinction)
direction_label_conventions.SK_LRT: departures from SW3 Sengkang; East Loop and West Loop
direction_label_conventions.PG_LRT: departures from PE1/PW1 Punggol; East Loop and West Loop

active_service_adjustments.adjustment: Services end at 11:30pm on Friday nights and commence at 8:30am on Saturday mornings. Shuttle buses S51, S52, S53 operate for TEL commuters from 5:00am to 8:30am on Saturday mornings.
active_service_adjustments.reason: Final systems integration tests for TEL5 with existing TEL network

active_service_adjustments.adjustment: Services end at 11:30pm on Friday nights and commence at 8:30am on Saturday mornings.
active_service_adjustments.reason: Final systems integration tests for DTL3e with existing DTL network

active_service_adjustments.adjustment: Sengkang West loop via SW1 Cheng Lim is closed. LRT services on West loop via SW8 Renjong operate normally.
active_service_adjustments.reason: Expansion of SPLRT depot and connection of new reception tracks

NEL.note: NE2 is not assigned. Numbering jumps from NE1 to NE3.

SK_LRT.note: Timings are departure times from Sengkang Town Centre (SW3/SE5). Sengkang West loop via SW1 Cheng Lim is closed from 2026-04-19 to 2026-10-18.

PG_LRT.note: Timings are departure times from Punggol Town Centre (PE1/PW1).

NSL.data_note: Northbound direction provided for all stations. Southbound provided only for NS1, NS24, NS25, NS26. Timings are approximate. Weekday/weekend split only (no separate Sat vs Sun/PH).

northbound.description: From NS1 Jurong East towards NS9 Woodlands (north), continuing south to NS28 Marina South Pier

southbound.description: From NS28 Marina South Pier towards NS9 Woodlands (north), continuing south-west to NS1 Jurong East. Partial data only.

EWL.data_note: Westbound direction provided for most stations. Eastbound provided only for EW12, EW13, EW14, EW24. Airport branch (CG1 Expo, CG2 Changi Airport) timing data not available from this source. Timings are approximate.

westbound.description: From EW1 Pasir Ris towards EW33 Tuas Link

eastbound.description: From EW33 Tuas Link towards EW1 Pasir Ris. Partial data only.

airport_branch.note: Timing data not available from scraped sources. Please refer to SMRT journey planner at journey.smrt.com.sg

CCL.data_note: Clockwise direction only (Dhoby Ghaut to HarbourFront). Counter-clockwise direction not available from this source. CCL Stage 6 (CC30 Keppel, CC31 Cantonment, CC32 Prince Edward Road) is not yet open - expected 12 July 2026. CC18 (Buona Vista? - actually CC18 is the old Botanic Gardens renaming - recheck) - note CC18 is Museum which is not open yet. Timings are approximate.
CCL.note_on_cc18: CC18 (Museum, formerly labelled as Botanic Gardens on old maps) is listed as not yet open. The station sequence skips from CC17 Caldecott to CC19 Botanic Gardens in the scraped data.

clockwise.description: From CC1 Dhoby Ghaut, clockwise around the partial loop to CC29 HarbourFront

TEL.data_note: Eastbound direction only. Several stations have no timing data (see individual station notes). TEL Stage 5 (Xilin, Bedok South, Sungei Bedok) not yet open. Active service adjustment: 2026-05-22 to 2026-07-04 - services end at 11:30pm Fridays and commence at 8:30am Saturdays. Timings are approximate.
